blocks.text: Shart bog'lovchilari: unless, as long as, provided

Shartni ifodalashning asosiy vositasi — **if** (→ qizil kitob, 99-dars; → 25, 38-darslar). Bu darsda shartning ikki xil «nozik» turi bilan tanishamiz. **unless** — «**agar ... bo'lmasa**», ya'ni if + inkor: I'll go **unless** it rains — Yomg'ir **yog'masa**, boraman. **as long as / so long as / provided (that) / providing (that)** — «**faqat ... bo'lsa**», «**... -sa bas**», «**... sharti bilan**»: shart bajarilsagina natija bo'ladi.

**unless** ichida inkor allaqachon bor, shuning uchun undan keyingi fe'l **darak** shaklda bo'ladi: **unless** you **hurry** (= if you don't hurry). O'zbekchada esa fe'l inkorda turadi: «**shoshilmasang**». unless ayniqsa ogohlantirish, tahdid va qat'iy shartlarda ko'p ishlatiladi: «... qilmasang, ... bo'ladi». **I won't ... unless ...** qolipi «faqat ... bo'lsagina ...» degan ma'noni beradi.

rows: I won't go **if** they **don't** invite me.
I won't go **unless** they invite me.

items.text: **Unless** you hurry, you'll miss the last bus.
I never work at weekends **unless** there's an urgent deadline.
items.translation: Shoshilinch topshiriq **bo'lmasa**, dam olish kunlari hech qachon ishlamayman.

items.text: The machine won't start **unless** you press both buttons.

blocks.text: Qachon unless emas, faqat if ... not

unless ma'nosi aslida «**... holatidan tashqari**» (except if): natija har doim bo'ladi, faqat bitta istisno bor. Shuning uchun ikki holatda faqat **if ... not** ishlatiladi: 1) inkorning o'zi natijaga **sabab** bo'lsa, ayniqsa his-tuyg'u bilan (xursand bo'laman, hayron qolaman, xafa bo'ladi); 2) **savollarda**: What will you do **if** ... **doesn't** ...? Ishonchingiz komil bo'lmasa — if ... not har doim to'g'ri.

items.text: I'll be glad **if** it **doesn't** rain on the day of the wedding.
What will you do **if** the bus **doesn't** come?

blocks.text: Turg'un ibora: **Unless I'm mistaken**, ... — «**Adashmayotgan bo'lsam**, ...». Muloyim e'tiroz bildirishda juda qulay: **Unless I'm mistaken**, the shop closes at six.
as long as / so long as / provided / providing

Bu to'rttasi bir ma'noda: «**faqat shu shart bajarilsa**». Ular natijaga yo'l qo'yishimiz uchun shart qo'yadi: You can borrow my car **as long as** you're careful with it — Ehtiyot **bo'lsang bas**, mashinamni olishing mumkin. **as long as** va **so long as** — og'zaki nutqda; **provided (that)** va **providing (that)** — rasmiyroq: shartnomalar, qoidalar, kafolatlar, yangiliklar. **that** ni tushirib qoldirish mumkin.

rows: You can stay **as long as** you're quiet.
Entry is free **provided (that)** you book online.
**Providing** you book online, entry is free.

items.text: You can use my laptop **as long as** you're careful with it.
**Provided that** the trials go well, the vaccine will be available next year.
items.translation: Sinovlar yaxshi **o'tsa**, vaksina kelasi yil sotuvga chiqadi.

blocks.text: if, when, in case dan keyingi kabi (→ 25, 114-darslar), **unless**, **as long as**, **provided** dan keyin ham kelajak haqida gapirsak **will** qo'yilmaydi: Present Simple (yoki tugallanganlikni ta'kidlash uchun Present Perfect) ishlatiladi: **unless** it **rains**, **as long as** you'**ve finished**. O'tmishdagi shart uchun Past ishlatiladi: We weren't allowed out **unless** we **had finished** our homework.

**as long as** ning boshqa ma'nolarini adashtirmang: vaqt — «... davomida», «... ekan» (I'll remember this day **as long as** I live); taqqoslash — «... chalik uzun» (The bridge is twice **as long as** the old one; → 107-dars).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: 1) «**Unless** you **don't** hurry» → **Unless** you **hurry** (unless ichida inkor bor; o'zbekchadagi «-masa» inkorini ko'chirmang). 2) «unless it **will** rain», «as long as you **will** pay» → **unless it rains**, **as long as you pay**. 3) «I'll be happy **unless** he comes» («kelmasa, xursand bo'laman») → I'll be happy **if** he **doesn't** come. 4) «**provide** that» → **provided** / **providing** that.

Tarjimada yordam beradigan juftlik: **unless** — «**-masa**» (inkor shart), **as long as / provided** — «**-sa bas**» (yagona shart). «bas» so'zini qo'shish mumkin bo'lsa — as long as yoki provided; «-masa» bo'lsa va ogohlantirish ohangi sezilsa — unless.

rows: as long as / so long as

examples.title: **Unless** = if ... not
examples.description: unless + darak fe'l = if + inkor. O'zbekchada «-masa», «... bo'lmasa». unless qismi gap boshida ham, oxirida ham turadi.

sentences.text: We'll have a barbecue in the garden **unless** it rains.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir **yog'masa**, bog'da kabob pishiramiz.

sentences.text: **Unless** you book now, there won't be any seats left for the concert.
sentences.translation: Hozir **band qilmasangiz**, konsertga bitta ham joy qolmaydi.

sentences.text: I don't drink coffee in the evening **unless** I have to work late.
sentences.translation: Kechgacha ishlashimga **to'g'ri kelmasa**, kechqurun qahva ichmayman.

sentences.text: You can't enter the building **unless** you have a security pass.
sentences.translation: Ruxsatnomangiz **bo'lmasa**, binoga kira olmaysiz.

sentences.text: Dilnoza never takes a taxi to work **unless** she's really late.
sentences.translation: Juda kechikkan **bo'lmasa**, Dilnoza ishga hech qachon taksida bormaydi.

sentences.text: **Unless** the wind drops, the ferry to the island will be cancelled.
sentences.translation: Shamol **pasaymasa**, orolga parom qatnovi bekor qilinadi.

sentences.text: The plants will die **unless** someone waters them while we're away.
sentences.translation: Biz yo'qligimizda kimdir **suv quymasa**, gullar qurib qoladi.

sentences.text: Don't call me at the office **unless** it's an emergency.
sentences.translation: Favqulodda holat **bo'lmasa**, menga ishxonaga qo'ng'iroq qilma.

sentences.text: Jasur won't get better **unless** he starts taking his medicine regularly.
sentences.translation: Dorisini muntazam **ichmasa**, Jasur tuzalmaydi.

sentences.text: Is there any point in going **unless** we can stay for the whole conference?
sentences.translation: Konferensiyada oxirigacha **qola olmasak**, borishning ma'nosi bormi?

examples.title: Warnings and conditions: **won't** ... **unless**
examples.description: unless ko'pincha ogohlantirish va qat'iy shartda: «... qilmasang, ...». I won't ... unless ... = «faqat ... bo'lsagina».

sentences.text: **Unless** you apologise, she'll never speak to you again.
sentences.translation: Kechirim **so'ramasang**, u sen bilan boshqa hech qachon gaplashmaydi.

sentences.text: I won't lend you the car **unless** you promise to drive carefully.
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot bo'lib haydashga **va'da bermasang**, mashinani bermayman.

sentences.text: The workers say they will go on strike **unless** they get a pay rise.
sentences.translation: Ishchilar maosh **oshirilmasa**, ish tashlashlarini aytishyapti.

sentences.text: You'll lose your place on the course **unless** you pay the fee by Friday.
sentences.translation: To'lovni jumagacha **to'lamasangiz**, kursdagi o'rningizdan ayrilasiz.

sentences.text: Bekzod won't sign the contract **unless** his lawyer reads it first.
sentences.translation: Avval advokati o'qib **chiqmasa**, Bekzod shartnomani imzolamaydi.

sentences.text: **Unless** we leave in the next ten minutes, we'll miss the start of the film.
sentences.translation: Keyingi o'n daqiqada **chiqmasak**, filmning boshiga ulgurmaymiz.

sentences.text: The bank won't give them a loan **unless** they can prove a regular income.
sentences.translation: Doimiy daromadlarini **isbotlay olmasalar**, bank ularga kredit bermaydi.

sentences.text: Your phone will keep freezing **unless** you delete some of those old videos.
sentences.translation: O'sha eski videolarning bir qismini **o'chirmasangiz**, telefoningiz qotib qolaveradi.

sentences.text: Nobody may leave the exam room **unless** a teacher goes with them.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi hamroh **bo'lmasa**, hech kim imtihon xonasidan chiqa olmaydi.

sentences.text: Our neighbours have threatened to call the police **unless** we turn the music down.
sentences.translation: Musiqani **pasaytirmasak**, qo'shnilarimiz politsiya chaqirishlarini aytib do'q qilishdi.

examples.title: **Unless** or **if** ... **not**?
examples.description: Ko'pincha ikkalasi ham mumkin. Lekin inkor natijaning sababi bo'lsa (xursand bo'laman, xafa bo'ladi) va savollarda — faqat if ... not.

sentences.text: You'll fail the module **if** you **don't** hand in the final essay.
sentences.translation: Yakuniy inshoni **topshirmasang**, bu fandan o'ta olmaysan.

sentences.text: **Unless** you submit the essay on time, you'll lose ten points.
sentences.translation: Inshoni o'z vaqtida **topshirmasang**, o'n ball yo'qotasan.

sentences.text: I'll be really relieved **if** it **doesn't** snow on the day of the flight.
sentences.translation: Parvoz kuni qor **yog'masa**, juda yengil tortaman.

sentences.text: Madina will be hurt **if** her brother **doesn't** come to her graduation.
sentences.translation: Akasi bitiruv kechasiga **kelmasa**, Madinaning ko'ngli qoladi.

sentences.text: What will you do **if** the visa **doesn't** arrive in time?
sentences.translation: Viza o'z vaqtida **kelmasa**, nima qilasiz?

sentences.text: We'll just eat at home **unless** you'd prefer to go out.
sentences.translation: Tashqarida ovqatlanishni **afzal ko'rmasang**, uyda ovqatlanaveramiz.

sentences.text: Grandma would be upset **if** we **didn't** visit her during the holidays.
sentences.translation: Ta'tilda uning oldiga **bormasak**, buvim xafa bo'lardi.

sentences.text: **Unless** I'm mistaken, this is the third time you've been late this week.
sentences.translation: **Adashmayotgan bo'lsam**, bu hafta uchinchi marta kechikishing.

sentences.text: It'll be much cheaper **if** we **don't** stay in the city centre.
sentences.translation: Shahar markazida **qolmasak**, ancha arzonroq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Oliver won't come to the party **unless** Emma invites him personally.
sentences.translation: Emma uni shaxsan **taklif qilmasa**, Oliver ziyofatga kelmaydi.

examples.title: **As long as** / **so long as**: only if
examples.description: as long as / so long as = «faqat ... bo'lsa», «... -sa bas». Shart bajarilsa, ruxsat yoki natija bor.

sentences.text: You can borrow my bike **as long as** you bring it back by six.
sentences.translation: Soat oltigacha **qaytarib bersang bas**, velosipedimni olishing mumkin.

sentences.text: **As long as** we leave before seven, we'll avoid the worst of the traffic.
sentences.translation: Yettidan oldin **chiqsak bas**, eng qattiq tirbandlikka tushmaymiz.

sentences.text: I don't mind where we eat **as long as** the food is halal.
sentences.translation: Taom halol **bo'lsa bas**, qayerda ovqatlanishimizning farqi yo'q.

sentences.text: The children can watch TV **as long as** they've finished their homework.
sentences.translation: Uy vazifasini **tugatgan bo'lsalar**, bolalar televizor ko'rishi mumkin.

sentences.text: **So long as** you keep the receipt, the shop will exchange the dress.
sentences.translation: Chekni **saqlab qo'ysangiz bas**, do'kon ko'ylakni almashtirib beradi.

sentences.text: My parents don't care what I study **as long as** I'm happy.
sentences.translation: **Baxtli bo'lsam bas**, nima o'qishim ota-onam uchun muhim emas.

sentences.text: Working from home is fine **as long as** your internet connection is reliable.
sentences.translation: Internet aloqangiz **ishonchli bo'lsa**, uydan ishlash ma'qul.

sentences.text: Sarah will take the job **as long as** she can finish early on Fridays.
sentences.translation: Juma kunlari ertaroq **ketishiga ruxsat berishsa**, Sara bu ishni oladi.

sentences.text: Any colour is fine for the kitchen **as long as** it isn't bright pink.
sentences.translation: Yorqin pushti **bo'lmasa bas**, oshxona uchun har qanday rang yaraydi.

sentences.text: Our team will stay in the Premier League **as long as** they don't lose on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni **yutqazmasa bas**, jamoamiz Premer-ligada qoladi.

examples.title: **Provided** / **providing (that)**: formal conditions
examples.description: provided (that) / providing (that) — as long as ning rasmiyroq sinonimi: qoidalar, shartnomalar, kafolatlar. O'zbekchada «... sharti bilan», «... bo'lgan taqdirda».

sentences.text: Guests may use the pool **provided that** they have a towel from reception.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar qabulxonadan sochiq **olgan bo'lsa**, basseyndan foydalanishi mumkin.

sentences.text: **Provided** the weather stays fine, the open-air concert will start at eight.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo yaxshi **bo'lib tursa**, ochiq havodagi konsert soat sakkizda boshlanadi.

sentences.text: The landlord will return your deposit **provided** the flat is clean when you leave.
sentences.translation: Chiqib ketayotganingizda kvartira toza **bo'lsa**, uy egasi garov pulingizni qaytaradi.

sentences.text: You can travel without a visa **providing** your stay is shorter than thirty days.
sentences.translation: Bo'lish muddatingiz o'ttiz kundan qisqa **bo'lsa**, vizasiz sayohat qilishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: **Providing that** the investors agree, construction will begin next spring.
sentences.translation: Investorlar rozi **bo'lgan taqdirda**, qurilish kelasi bahorda boshlanadi.

sentences.text: The laptop is guaranteed for two years **provided that** it hasn't been damaged by water.
sentences.translation: Suvdan **shikastlanmagan bo'lsa**, noutbukka ikki yil kafolat beriladi.

sentences.text: Employees may work from home on Mondays **provided** their manager agrees.
sentences.translation: Rahbari **rozi bo'lsa**, xodimlar dushanba kunlari uydan ishlashi mumkin.

sentences.text: Aziz has agreed to lend us the money **provided** we pay it back within a year.
sentences.translation: Bir yil ichida **qaytarish sharti bilan**, Aziz bizga pul qarz berishga rozi bo'ldi.

sentences.text: **Provided** there are no further delays, the new metro line will open in December.
sentences.translation: Boshqa kechikishlar **bo'lmasa**, yangi metro liniyasi dekabrda ochiladi.

sentences.text: Patients can go home the same day **providing** someone is there to look after them.
sentences.translation: Ularga qaraydigan kimdir **bo'lsa**, bemorlar o'sha kuniyoq uyga ketishi mumkin.

examples.title: Future and past: **unless it rains**, **as long as we didn't**
examples.description: Kelajak haqida ham unless, as long as, provided dan keyin will emas — Present (yoki Present Perfect). O'tmishdagi shartda — Past.

sentences.text: **Unless** the price comes down, we won't buy a new car this year.
sentences.translation: Narx **tushmasa**, bu yil yangi mashina olmaymiz.

sentences.text: I'll finish the report tonight **as long as** nobody interrupts me.
sentences.translation: Hech kim **xalaqit bermasa**, hisobotni bugun kechqurun tugataman.

sentences.text: We'll arrive well before lunch **provided** the mountain roads aren't icy.
sentences.translation: Tog' yo'llari muz **bo'lmasa**, tushlikdan ancha oldin yetib boramiz.

sentences.text: **As long as** you've packed your passport, everything else can be bought there.
sentences.translation: Pasportingni **olib olgan bo'lsang bas**, qolgan hamma narsani u yerdan sotib olsa bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Kate will move to Edinburgh next year **unless** her company opens an office in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyasi Manchesterda ofis **ochmasa**, Keyt kelasi yil Edinburgga ko'chadi.

sentences.text: As a child, I wasn't allowed to go out **unless** I'd finished my homework.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimda uy vazifamni **tugatmagan bo'lsam**, tashqariga chiqishimga ruxsat berilmasdi.

sentences.text: The museum let us take photos **as long as** we didn't use a flash.
sentences.translation: Chaqnoqni **ishlatmasak bas**, muzey suratga olishimizga ruxsat berdi.

sentences.text: Nilufar said she would come **provided** she could bring her little sister.
sentences.translation: Nilufar singlisini olib kelishi **mumkin bo'lsa**, kelishini aytdi.

sentences.text: There'll be no problem with your application **as long as** you've filled in the form correctly.
sentences.translation: Anketani to'g'ri **to'ldirgan bo'lsangiz**, arizangiz bilan muammo bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: Grandpa will come home on Saturday **unless** the doctors find something serious.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar jiddiy biror narsa **topmasa**, bobom shanba kuni uyga qaytadi.

examples.title: Dialogue: renting a flat in London
examples.description: Ijarachi va uy egasi shartlarni kelishib olmoqda: unless, as long as, provided, providing va if.

sentences.text: — I love the flat. Could I move in next week, **provided** the paperwork is ready?
sentences.translation: — Kvartira menga juda yoqdi. Hujjatlar tayyor **bo'lsa**, kelasi hafta ko'chib kirsam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: — Yes, **as long as** you pay the first month's rent in advance.
sentences.translation: — Ha, birinchi oyning ijara haqini oldindan **to'lasangiz bas**.

sentences.text: — That's fine. Can I keep a cat **as long as** it stays indoors?
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Mushuk uydan **chiqmasa**, uni boqsam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: — Hmm, I don't usually allow pets **unless** the tenant pays an extra deposit.
sentences.translation: — Hmm, ijarachi qo'shimcha garov **to'lamasa**, odatda uy hayvonlariga ruxsat bermayman.

sentences.text: — I'd be happy to pay more **provided** it's returned when I leave.
sentences.translation: — Ketganimda **qaytarilsa**, ko'proq to'lashga roziman.

sentences.text: — Of course, **providing** there's no damage to the furniture.
sentences.translation: — Albatta, mebelga zarar **yetmagan bo'lsa**.

sentences.text: — Could I repaint the bedroom, **unless** you'd rather I didn't?
sentences.translation: — Yotoqxonani qayta bo'yasam bo'ladimi, agar **qarshi bo'lmasangiz**?

sentences.text: — You can, **as long as** you choose a light, neutral colour.
sentences.translation: — Mumkin, faqat och, oddiy rang **tanlasangiz bas**.

sentences.text: — Great. What happens **if** I need to leave before the end of the year?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Yil tugamasdan ketishimga **to'g'ri kelsa**, nima bo'ladi?

sentences.text: — You won't lose your deposit **unless** you leave without giving two months' notice.
sentences.translation: — Ikki oy oldin ogohlantirmasdan **ketmasangiz**, garovingizdan ayrilmaysiz.

examples.title: Mixed: news, health and everyday rules
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: unless, as long as, provided, providing va if ... not murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: **Unless** governments act quickly, many coastal cities could be under water within a century.
sentences.translation: Hukumatlar tezda **chora ko'rmasa**, ko'plab qirg'oqbo'yi shaharlari bir asr ichida suv ostida qolishi mumkin.

sentences.text: The new law lets drivers use their phones **provided** they don't hold them in their hands.
sentences.translation: Yangi qonunga ko'ra, haydovchilar telefonni qo'lida **ushlamasa**, undan foydalanishi mumkin.

sentences.text: You can say anything in this group **as long as** you're respectful to other members.
sentences.translation: Boshqa a'zolarni **hurmat qilsangiz bas**, bu guruhda istalgan narsani aytishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: Most experts agree that a little coffee is harmless **unless** you have heart problems.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik mutaxassislarning fikricha, yurak bilan muammongiz **bo'lmasa**, ozgina qahva zararsiz.

sentences.text: **As long as** the company keeps making a profit, nobody will lose their job.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya foyda **ko'rishda davom etsa**, hech kim ishidan ayrilmaydi.

sentences.text: I'll be surprised **if** the train **isn't** late again — it's been late all week.
sentences.translation: Poyezd yana **kechikmasa**, hayron bo'laman — butun hafta kechikdi.

sentences.text: **Unless** I hear from you, I'll assume the meeting is still at ten.
sentences.translation: Sizdan xabar **bo'lmasa**, uchrashuv hali ham soat o'nda deb hisoblayman.

sentences.text: Jasur can join the national team **providing** he passes the medical next week.
sentences.translation: Kelasi hafta tibbiy ko'rikdan **o'tsa**, Jasur terma jamoaga qo'shilishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Tourists can visit the mosque **as long as** they cover their shoulders and knees.
sentences.translation: Yelka va tizzalarini **yopib olsalar bas**, sayyohlar masjidni ziyorat qilishlari mumkin.

sentences.text: Why would anyone pay for an app **unless** it offered something the free ones don't?
sentences.translation: Bepullarida yo'q biror narsani **taklif qilmasa**, nega kimdir ilova uchun pul to'lardi?
